name: shiori-site-video
description: Remotion source of the feature demo clips on the Shiori website (#772), and the scripts that prepare the site's committed pictures: the showcase stills (apps/site/src/assets/showcase/) and the photo strip's thumbnails (apps/site/src/assets/gallery/). The videos render into out/ and are not committed (#790).
//dependencies: Remotion packages are pinned to one exact version (they must match each other). react, @phosphor-icons/react, typescript and the @types ranges stay identical to apps/desktop and apps/site so pnpm resolves them to the same store entries.
